* [001 — Keep re-export shims for external peer deps - they dedupe esbuild bundle imports](entries/001.md) — esbuild emits one external-module import per source statement and never cross-file merges them, minified or not; a re-export shim collapses N consumers to one import. * [007 — SSR package design — ssr() stringifier + hydration forks resolved (DECISION, UNBUILT)](entries/007.md) — DECIDED 2026-07-07, NOT YET BUILT. No packages/ssr/ exists today; only the plans (plans/ssr/code/ssr-v1.md, plans/ssr/code/hydration-design.md). The planned @hellajs/ssr package will export ssr(node): string — a zero-dep HellaNode AST walker returning HTML, with no runtime imports from any @hellajs/* package. resource will guard run() with hasWindow() (no fetch server-side). Client enhancement model for v1: $ref/$collection bind existing nodes, mount(Island, '#empty-slot') adds reactive islands — NOT full re-mount (footgun: packages/dom/lib/mount.ts:59 replaceChildren wipes server HTML). Hydration is a v2 candidate, fully specified but NOT pre-committed. ForEach key contract = Option C (re-run-and-match, no markers). Anchor placement = re-run-to-determine-extent. Mismatch = warn + subtree-replace. CSS = separate server/client style elements. All design forks resolved; build/don't-build waits for v1 usage data. · `triggers: ssr-design, hydration-design, forEach-adoption, enhancement-model, ssr-naming` · `tags: arch, ssr, hydration, dom, resource` · `type: decision`
